description: Transfer to third country without adequacy decision lacks appropriate safeguards as required by Article 46. Safeguards include binding corporate rules, standard contractual clauses, or approved codes of conduct.
applicability: Applicable to transfers to third countries without adequacy decision. Controller or processor must provide appropriate safeguards and ensure enforceable data subject rights.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of contracts with third country processors and absence of appropriate safeguards mechanisms.
